signature.name: VTask.mk
signature.type: {ι : Type u} -> {α : ι → Type v} -> (l : List ι) -> (_f : (i : ι) → α i) -> List.TProd α l

conventions.statement: When `l` is the empty list, `VTask.mk [] f` is `PUnit.unit`, the unique element of `PUnit`, regardless of `f`.
conventions.note: This is the base case of the recursion; the function argument is ignored.

conventions.statement: When `l` is `i :: is`, `VTask.mk (i :: is) f` is the pair `(f i, VTask.mk is f)`, a right-nested product.
conventions.note: The first component is `f i` and the second component is the `TProd` for the tail `is`.

facts.statement: example : (VTask.mk ([0] : List Nat) (fun i => i + 1)).1 = 1 := by decide
